hypothesis: DPF changes odd/even match combination for sprite-playfield collisions; PF-PF behavior must be measured separately.
test: 512 cases: paired DPF bit, four plane patterns, four enabled-plane masks, four desired patterns, sprite0 on/off, two repeats. Two independent A500 packets. Settled scanline44, no Copper or blitter.
next_question: Which settled collision bits differ solely because DPF is enabled?
competitor: Mode differences are only visual or timing-dependent; settled CLXDAT bits match for identical plane data and masks.

outcomes.stable mode-dependent bits: Pin each measured collision bit in Copperline regression tests.
outcomes.stable identical bits: Record mode independence for this specific bit/path; do not generalize to other collision paths.
outcomes.sprite controls or repeats fail: Repair measurement before deriving emulator expectations.

decision_reason: 512 independently repeated observations are stable.24 paired sprite-PF1 mode differences agree with existing matcher. PF-PF has328 disagreements: live readback uses visible opacity and DPF gating instead of CLXCON matches; zero BPLDAT and constant DMA samples account for all hardware PF-PF results. Add consensus fixture and correct only that live DMA path.
